hook.line: Creator Search Insights has just upgraded - and you might be using it wrong.
hook.visual: Selfie close-up, face blurred and lunging toward the lens, then sharp; white title box at top reads 'Creator Search Insights has UPGRADED. Step by step...' and captions low.

beats.what: Lunges into the camera with the 'has upgraded' news line; permanent title box at top
Promises it will fix your views, then asks viewers to engage so it gets pushed out
Explains the tool as TikTok handing you a book of what is trending
'Here's what you do' - step-by-step walkthrough starts
Screenshot of the Creator Search Insights content-gap tab floats over her shoulder
Second screenshot: the list of suggested topics, 'it gives you the hooks'
AI outline screen with keyboard shown while she gestures at it
AI outline result with script sections: hook, caption, hashtags
Verdict: 10 out of 10, use it every day
Asks for comments and a follow

why_it_works: News framing ('has just upgraded') plus a pain point ('low view jail') gives both urgency and a personal stake
A fixed title box states the whole promise, so a viewer who joins at any second knows what the video is
Mid-video engagement ask ('engage so it gets pushed out') turns the viewer's comment into a favour to others, driving 1165 comments
Screenshots of the actual app tabs make the steps copyable while she keeps talking
weaknesses: 167 s with zero cuts; the first proof screenshot only arrives near 60 s
Lots of filler ('literally', 'like it gives you') stretches each step
Screenshots are small and partly covered by her hand, hard to read on a phone
for_robert: Keep one fixed title box with the full promise on screen for the whole reel; avoid her one-minute wait before the first visual proof - show the tool screen within 10 s.
